source: The status bar shows the display locale. Click it, or run "x18n: Set Display Locale", to change it. The pick holds for the current workspace and is kept in the extension's workspace state, so it never lands in {0} or in the repo. It overrides the {1} setting until that setting changes. To go back to the setting, or to the source locale when the setting is empty, pick "Default" or edit the setting.
text: 状态栏显示当前的显示语言。点击它，或运行 "x18n: Set Display Locale"，即可更改。所选语言对当前工作区有效，并保存在扩展的工作区状态中，因此不会写入 {0}，也不会进入仓库。在该设置发生变化之前，它会覆盖 {1} 设置。若要恢复为该设置，或在设置为空时恢复为源语言，请选择 "Default" 或编辑该设置。
